defects.description: Incorrect term used for "authoritative name server"; the required equivalent is "авторитетный сервер имён".
Incorrect term used for "caching name server"; the required equivalent is "кэширующий сервер имён".
The term "slave" is rendered as "подчиненным (slave)" without the required noun "сервер"; the required equivalent is "подчиненный сервер".
Incorrect translation of "Ports Collection"; the required equivalent is "коллекция портов".
